create_dataset_sunrgbd_detection: create a SunrgbdDetectionVotesDataset instance for 3D object detection on SUN RGB-D with configurable split, augmentation, and feature options
get_item_dataset_sample: get a dataset sample dict containing point clouds, bounding box labels, vote labels, and semantic class labels from SunrgbdDetectionVotesDataset
visualize_point_votes: visualize point votes and vote mask labels by writing object point clouds and their three vote-displaced versions to PLY files
visualize_oriented_bounding_boxes: visualize oriented bounding box ground truth by writing 3D oriented boxes and centroids to PLY files
compute_semantic_class_statistics: compute and print the number of objects per semantic class by iterating over the full dataset
